responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s core exploded-graph framework for symbolic execution over <program_point, program_state> pairs. It defines impl_region_model_context, point_and_state keys, exploded_node and exploded_edge graph infrastructure, per-point/call-string/function caches, diagnostic-manager ownership, feasibility checking support, exploded_path and feasibility_problem representations, and the interfaces through which the engine builds, processes, summarizes, and diagnoses paths through the supergraph.
